name: Honoo no Haramase Oppai Shintai Sokutei ~Osananajimi Joshikousei Shintai Sokutei de Zen'in Nakadashi Paradise!~
original_name: 炎の孕ませおっぱい身体測定～幼なじみ女子校生身体測定で全員中出しパラダイス！～
source:
Yuuya suddenly takes in charge of a substitute sick-room teacher of his school though he is still a student. There are a lot of his childhood friends at school, so he is excited to do physical checkups. His evil ambition gradually comes out and he decides to make all female students pregnant...! 

[From ErogeShop]
